tabs.description: Ordered list of pinned navigation tabs shown in the sidebar for the authenticated user within the current team. Send the full list to replace the existing pins; omit to leave them unchanged.

homepage.description: Tab descriptor for the user's chosen home page — the destination opened when they click the PostHog logo or hit `/`. Set to a tab descriptor to pick a homepage, send `null` or `{}` to clear it and fall back to the project default.
